technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 1.5g, this KoColor EYESHADOW is expertly formulated with Mica, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Silica, Titanium Dioxide. Delivering a high-fidelity Starlight Sparkle color profile (`#F7E7CE`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
